title: Truck Dispatcher: What the Role Is and What the Federal Rules Say About Dispatching
excerpt: A truck dispatcher is not a defined legal category, but dispatching decisions are covered by hours-of-service, fatigue and coercion rules. A worked check shows when a plan cannot be driven legally.
meta_title: Truck Dispatcher: The Role and the Federal Rules
meta_description: What a truck dispatcher is under federal rules: the hours-of-service, fatigue and coercion regulations that reach dispatching, and a worked check of a day's loads.
